# Billables AI

Billables AI is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Billables AI provides automated timekeeping and task intelligence solutions designed for lawyers, consultants, and professional services. They capture billable time automatically while attorneys work and turn daily activity into accurate, ready-to-review entries for their clients. Billables AI employs 14 people (+27.3% YoY, +3 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Canada.

## About

Our mission is to transform the way professional service providers work, freeing them up to focus on the most creative and intellectual parts of their business. 

The Billables AI Automated Time Report is a first-of-its-kind professional service product, powered by AI and designed for lawyers, agencies, and consultants. We’re building state-of-the-art AI tools to help people reduce the time spent on mundane operational tasks. Our team brings a deep history of AI expertise, B2B software development, and user-centric product experiences to transform billing and timekeeping forever.
